meta.project: PROJECT+PLAN SUPABASE - Course sales and admin

product_overview: Web application to publish and sell online courses with user registration, manual payment validation and an admin panel to manage courses, users and payments (see PRD images: overview on pages 1–4, modules and payment states on pages 5–9, and executive summary on page 12).
core_goals: Allow prospective students to discover available courses and view price and description
Let visitors register and sign in to buy courses and manage their purchases
Permit users to register purchases and upload payment receipts for manual validation
Provide administrators a private panel to create and manage courses, review uploads and validate payments
Activate course access only for users whose payments are approved

features.name: Landing page (public)
features.description: Present the product, benefits and highlighted courses to visitors so they can discover offerings before registering.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read product overview and benefits -> See list of highlighted courses and pricing -> Navigate to /courses to view the full catalog

features.name: User registration
features.description: Create a new user account with email and password so the user can buy courses and see their purchases.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Fill in password confirmation -> Submit registration form -> See success message or automatic sign-in
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Fill in non-matching password confirmation -> Submit registration form -> See validation error about password confirmation

features.name: User authentication (login)
features.description: Authenticate existing users with email and password to access protected areas like the courses catalog and dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See redirect to /dashboard on success
Navigate to /auth/login -> Submit login form with missing email or password -> See validation error for required fields

features.name: Course browsing
features.description: Browse the catalog of available courses and inspect course descriptions and pricing before purchasing.
user_flows: Navigate to /courses -> View list of available courses -> Select a course to view its details -> See course description and pricing

features.name: Course purchase (initiate and pay)
features.description: Initiate a purchase for a selected course, provide payment details or receipt, and receive confirmation that the purchase was recorded.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Authenticate -> Navigate to /courses -> View list of available courses -> Select a course to purchase -> Initiate purchase -> See purchase confirmation modal -> Provide payment information or upload receipt -> Confirm purchase -> See purchase success message -> Navigate to /dashboard to verify purchase appears in history

features.name: Upload payment receipt and view purchase state
features.description: Allow users to attach payment evidence (comprobante) to a pending purchase and monitor its validation state (pending / approved / rejected).
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View purchase history -> Select a purchase with 'pending' status -> Upload payment receipt and submit -> See upload success message and updated purchase state as pending
Navigate to /dashboard -> Attempt to submit a receipt without required fields -> See validation error asking for missing information

features.name: User dashboard (enrollments & purchases)
features.description: Show authenticated users their enrolled courses and detailed purchase history so they can track access and payment status.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See list of enrolled courses and purchases -> Select a purchase to see its current payment status and any uploaded receipts -> If payment is approved, observe access state as active

features.name: Admin dashboard (overview)
features.description: Give administrators a private overview of site statistics, pending payments and shortcuts to management sections.
user_flows: Authenticate as admin (via /auth/login) -> Navigate to /admin -> View admin statistics and overview including counts of pending payments and active courses -> Navigate to specific admin management sections as needed

features.name: Admin course management (create / list / delete / toggle)
features.description: Allow admins to create new courses, view the course list, modify course details and change course state so the catalog stays current.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/cursos -> View list of courses -> Navigate to /admin/cursos/nuevo to create a course -> Fill course form with title, description and price -> Submit form -> See success message and new course listed on /admin/cursos
Navigate to /admin/cursos -> Choose an existing course from the list to edit -> Modify course details -> Submit changes -> See success message and updated course in list
Navigate to /admin/cursos -> Choose an existing course -> Request course deletion -> Confirm deletion -> See course removed from list

features.name: Admin student management
features.description: Provide admins a view of registered students and their enrollments so they can inspect and assist users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/estudiantes -> View list of all students -> Select a student to see enrollment and purchase summary -> Review student's purchase history and access states

features.name: Admin payment management (validate receipts)
features.description: Enable administrators to review uploaded payment receipts and change payment status to approve or reject, which controls course access.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/pagos -> View list of payments and their statuses -> Open a pending payment to review uploaded receipt and details -> Mark payment as approved -> See payment status change to approved and associated purchase access updated to active
Navigate to /admin/pagos -> Open a pending payment -> Mark payment as rejected -> Optionally add observations -> See payment status change to rejected and purchase state updated

features.name: Reporting (basic admin reports)
features.description: Allow admins to inspect basic reports such as total sales, pending payments and most-sold courses to monitor business metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View available reports and indicators (total sales, payments pending/approved/rejected, top courses) -> Filter or inspect a specific report to see counts and totals
